title: Provision of Staking Services for Virtual Assets from Custodial Services
summary: On 7 April 2025, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) issued a circular titled 'Provision of Staking Services for Virtual Assets from Custodial Services.' Staking involves committing virtual assets to a proof-of-stake blockchain's validation process, typically in exchange for rewards; this circular addresses that activity specifically where an Authorized Institution provides it in connection with virtual assets the institution already holds for clients through its own custodial arrangements.
why_it_matters: Staking is a common way for holders of proof-of-stake virtual assets to earn rewards, but doing it through a bank raises custody-style risks for the client if something goes wrong. This circular is how HKMA, Hong Kong's banking regulator, addresses that specific activity for the Authorized Institutions it supervises.
